title: IdentityDigestVectors
description: The pinned identity-digest protocol vectors (docs/IDENTITY_DIGEST.md). A consumer pins schema_version 1, implements the algorithm independently, and asserts every case. Each case's sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of its payload, both computed by the reference implementation named in the document. A change to the algorithm, the digested field set or these vectors needs a new schema_version; a consumer fails closed on an unknown one.

digests.description: Which subject the payload is: StateSnapshot content, DecisionProposal, or ExecutionIntent payload.

payload.description: The exact object that is digested. For a snapshot or proposal it is the contract's complete serialized form, so a consumer digests the payload it receives without adding, removing or normalizing a field.

document.description: Raw JSON document text, because an out-of-domain or non-finite number cannot be carried in a JSON payload.

path.description: JSON path of the offending value, or null when the implementation can only refuse the document as a whole.
